links.outcome: LLM diagnostic performance in multi-turn interactive reasoning versus single-turn benchmark-style vignettes
links.effect: LLMs competent diagnosing from well-described presentations, but performance degrades significantly in iterative diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty on VivaBench (1762 vignettes).
links.quote: While current LLMs demonstrate competence in diagnosing conditions from well-described clinical presentations, their performance degrades significantly when required to navigate iterative diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty in our evaluation.

links.outcome: Failure modes in LLM diagnostic reasoning, including failing to screen for critical conditions
links.effect: Identified failure modes: fixation on initial hypotheses, inappropriate investigation ordering, premature diagnostic closure, and failing to screen for critical conditions.
links.quote: Our analysis identified several failure modes that mirror common cognitive errors in clinical practice, including: (1) fixation on initial hypotheses, (2) inappropriate investigation ordering, (3) premature diagnostic closure, and (4) failing to screen for critical conditions.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM agents on a multi-turn clinical reasoning benchmark (VivaBench) consisting of simulated oral exam clinical vignettes, identifying diagnostic failure modes but not evaluating a specific health care organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
